items.name: Default-on sidecamerad beside unchanged native camerad
Explicit side-to-path mapping with by-path support
SideCameraAvailability JSON dictionary and reset transitions
Four isolated position-specific side camera streams
Four matching 20 Hz camera state topics
No-path warning and SIGINT/SIGTERM idle wait

boundaries.control: Keep the sidecar separate, cap workers/decoder threads, run only configured feeds, preserve the signal-wait idle branch, and leave native camerad unchanged.
Validate explicit per-side device paths, resolve targets under /dev as image-node character devices, reject metadata-only nodes, pass a path only as data, and never infer sides from USB order.
Treat MJPEG as untrusted; use fixed format and worker/thread/buffer limits, accept exact complete frames only, close/reap/retry failed children, and report any unavailable hard resource limit.
Use fixed direct argv without a shell, pass only the validated path, close unrelated inherited descriptors, retain the unprivileged identity, and bound diagnostics.

Write only the complete four-boolean JSON value under one lock on state transitions, initialize all false, set true only after matching dual publication, clear on loss/orderly shutdown, and reset at manager start.
Keep imagery on existing host-local VisionIPC/cereal interfaces with local permissions; add no network listener, persistent sink, or remote consumer.

security_seed.reason: Default-on operation increases capture exposure for configured peripherals, and the design crosses a local device/decoder boundary while publishing potentially sensitive imagery to local IPC. Explicit path validation, bounded least-privilege decoding, controlled status writes, and host-local publication are required.
security_seed.scope: Default-on sidecamerad capture of explicitly configured local V4L2 image nodes, untrusted MJPEG decoding through FFmpeg, transition-only Params availability state, and host-local VisionIPC/cereal publication.

stack_lock.reason: no new runtime or framework - existing stack unchanged
stack_lock.scope: sidecamerad r2 reuses the existing openpilot Python/C++/Cap'n Proto/msgq stack and installed FFmpeg; no packages installed

ui_evidence.reason: no user-facing surface - design system not engaged
ui_evidence.scope: sidecamerad r2 is a backend process and local IPC change with no user-facing screen
